contract: Present Janssen Cosmetics as a refined, product-first home-care showcase for salon clients, with product imagery first, skin needs and consultation second, and deferred supporting videos last; keep the existing salon identity and remain responsive from 390px to 1440px.

contractDetails.surface: Janssen Cosmetics product-introduction section on the Hoang Yen Beauty & Spa website
contractDetails.userJob: Understand the available professional home-care products and request a tailored recommendation
contractDetails.primaryAction: Open the prefilled WhatsApp consultation link
contractDetails.hierarchy: Product imagery first, product purpose and skin needs second, consultation and client offer third, supporting video reels last
contractDetails.tone: Refined editorial skincare showcase aligned with the existing cream, brown and gold salon identity
contractDetails.memorableDetail: Layered product still-life with a deep green professional-care seal
contractDetails.constraints: Static HTML/CSS/JavaScript, existing assets only, responsive from 390px to 1440px, keyboard-focusable horizontal reels, videos deferred until playback

accessibility.evidence: Product images have descriptive alternative text, videos have controls and accessible labels, the horizontal reel track is keyboard focusable with a visible focus ring, and actions remain visible text links.

responsive.evidence: Rendered at 390x844 and 1440x900 with no horizontal page overflow; the desktop two-column showcase becomes a single column and the video grid becomes a touch-scroll reel on mobile.

loading.reason: The section uses local static copy and images; videos intentionally remain poster-only until the visitor presses play.

empty.reason: Product content and local media are authored directly in the page and are not data-driven.

error.reason: There is no remote data request or transactional state inside this product-introduction section.

partial.reason: All product copy and media ship with the static site as one release.

success.evidence: The completed section presents the product range, consultation value, salon-client offer, WhatsApp action and three supporting videos.

permission.reason: Viewing the product section requires no account, device permission or authenticated access.

renderedEvidence.observation: Layered product still-life remains legible without clipped captions; content becomes one column and no page-level overflow is present.
Product imagery and editorial copy form a balanced two-column first viewport with clear skin-need scanning and visual continuity with the site header.
